config.design: Exact weighted residual-write decomposition of frozen preMLP4 rank1 coordinate. At matching relay token: attention head outputs atL0..4 plusMLP outputsL0..3, weighted by subsequent residual lambdas. Same-token embedding difference cancels. Rank49 writers by discovery8pairs/task RMS signed contribution; freeze top3. Evaluate all freshH849 cases, both directions, without reselecting.
config.causal: Each top3 writer full-vector donor delta or coordinate-only donor delta at original write site; top3 joint full and joint axial. Axial uses upstream dot(q)*q, not transport-weight multiplied twice. Measure observed preMLP4 coordinate change and final answer change; native accounting is not causal attribution.
config.scope: Exploratory writer selection, frozen before fresh writer tests, but fresh panel already used for direction validation. Not independently fresh for overall research. Task-specific rank1 directions retained. All gates/alignment inherited, no exclusions by effects.
